name: Syncthing
description: Keep folders in sync between this NAS, laptops, phones and other servers. Syncthing transfers directly between devices — no cloud account in the middle — and the shared folders are your real shares under /mnt and /media. The web GUI opens in its own EthOS window; set a GUI username and password on the first visit, because port 8384 is reachable on your network.
author: SyncHot
changelog: 1.0.2: shorter release notes in Package Center (no behaviour change). 1.0.1: Syncthing runs with the NAS service uid/gid, so synced files stay editable by EthOS and share users; the healthcheck uses /rest/noauth/health. 1.0.0: first release — Syncthing 2.1.7 pinned, a config volume that survives updates, /mnt and /media mounted read-write for syncing, the sync protocol on 22000 tcp/udp and local discovery on 21027/udp. The GUI listens on port 8384 so the EthOS window can embed it; set a GUI username and password on the first visit.
